ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Early field experience require Illinois State Criminal Background Check (See Council on Teacher Education for questions) and annual bloodborne pathogen training. Includes 28 hours of early field experiences in area schools. Students must reserve one block of 4 consecutive hours each week between 8 am and 3 pm Mon-Thurs for field placement.
